design.session: jobs.rs: JobLifecycle::admit refuses typed in order canceled -> stale_revision {expected, head} -> overloaded {retry_after_ms}; AdmittedJob releases exactly once at settle/complete or settles abandoned on drop; Superseded on a Committed job is recorded failed not_replaceable; counters (JobCounts) and one Observe terminal frame per outcome (codes, bound revision, opaque correlation id). AdmissionJobPort is asset-local (DESCRIPTOR key job_lifecycle, version 6). JobPort trait and Admission signatures unchanged.
design.export: export_queue stays the only ExportQueue constructor in product src; timeline_export::admitted_export_queue wraps it with a JobAdmission. Export Media (headless and window) admits before submit/thread/encoder; the settlement stays on the UI thread and is taken from the worker's receipt after join (cancel path included); result["job"], state_json running.job_tickets and the status line (completed_stale names both revisions).
design.audio_batch: AudioBatchQueue::new(actor) keeps its signature (6 harness test sites) and admits through an asset-local admission; with_jobs binds the viewer's; AudioBatchReceipt gains job (settlement or refusal JSON).
design.preview: preview_gate.rs: Viewer::gate_preview at display time; frame revision != head -> Superseded {revision: head}, counter + JobLifecycle::record_superseded + status line, viewer stays dirty; previews are not admitted (synchronous).
